title: tab into field selects text
rule: Tab into a text field selects existing text.
pass_when: Keyboard focus into a text field with existing text selects that text.
fail_when: Tab-in places a caret without selecting existing text.
overview: Tabbing into a text field selects the existing text for immediate replacement.
apply_when: Keyboard focus into filled text fields during form editing.
not_when: Empty fields, mouse click-to-caret placement, or non-text controls.
agent_hint: On keyboard focus into a filled text field, select the existing text.
description: When someone tabs into a Spectrum text field that already has content, the existing text should be selected so typing replaces it immediately. Placing a caret without selection forces extra keystrokes to clear or overwrite the value. Apply on keyboard focus into filled text inputs during form editing; do not change empty fields, mouse click-to-caret placement inside the value, or non-text controls that use different focus behavior.
